summary: Check-Cap Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing completion of its merger with MBody AI Corp., where MBody AI became a wholly-owned subsidiary. Each MBody AI share converted into 0.07971678051816 Check-Cap ordinary shares, issuing ~12,379,581 shares representing ~90% of the post-closing company, with no cash consideration. The transaction constitutes a change of control, and Nasdaq approved the listing under symbol MBAI on August 21, 2026. Concurrently, the Apollo Business Combination Agreement was terminated, and $16.3 million Apollo loans were exchanged for a 7.5% equity interest in Apollo. Executive changes occurred: John Fowler became CEO and Tim Hayden CFO. Watch for post-merger integration and stock performance under the new MBAI ticker.
